confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several crowd-sourced cost-of-living listings for Lugano and Swiss national averages, so they are medium quality. Beer is medium-high in the sense of multiple consistent sources. Cocktail and wine are low: no current Lugano per-glass or per-drink price was found, so cocktail uses a 2022 Expatistan data point and Swiss hotel-bar anecdotes, and wine is set relative to the local beer price. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for July peak season, with no live listings checked. CHF amounts were converted to USD at roughly 1.22 USD per CHF, using conversions shown by a cost-of-living site; that is not an RBA rate. The FX observation came from a search summary of RBA pages (overview page, 4pm 15 Oct 2026 indicative rate). The F11.1 table itself was not opened, so the figure should be checked against it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a Swiss Italian-speaking (Ticino) tourist city. Restaurant anchors follow Lugano listings on Numbeo and similar sites and Swiss three-course dinner benchmarks. Coffee and beer are set below German-speaking Swiss averages, reflecting Ticino café pricing. Accommodation is benchmarked against typical Swiss lake-city hotel and hostel levels in summer.
